how: One transaction against the Supabase project comms-hub, rolled back at the end. Five throwaway accounts (@t.test) act through row level security in one group; the member mutes it. 0 throwaway accounts left afterwards.

runs.when: after the drop; checks 04 and 21b read `urgency` only

rules_checked: level 1 is anyone's (a writer, a member); it tells the other members as «انتباه», not the author and not a member who muted the conversation; worded «للانتباه» من <name> في «<room>»: <text>.
level 2 without «رسائل «مهم»» is refused (URGENCY_2) and nothing is stored; the assistant sends it by role template; it tells as «انتباه» worded «مهم», muted member skipped
a one-time level-2 grant is used by the send, once: the second is refused, the grant has 0 uses left and one use is logged
a level-2 card refused for another reason (a poll with one option) uses nothing: the one-time grant keeps its use
a temporary grant works within its time and is refused at use after its end (no sweep)
a standing removal beats the role template (the director stops «مهم» for the assistant)

level 3 is fixed: a writer is refused (URGENT_ROLE), through the boolean form too; it cannot be granted (CAP_FIXED); the director sends it; the author counts as acknowledged; every other member is told as «قرارك», the muted member too, asked to acknowledge
the boolean form of chat_send still means level 3
acknowledgement only at level 3 (FORBIDDEN on levels 1 and 2)
level 0 tells nobody; a level above 3 or below 0 is refused (BAD_URGENCY)
